Chapter 7075: High Heaven Enforcer Slash

Chapter 7075: High Heaven Enforcer Slash

“Boom!” The empowered platform revealed something new - an egg originating from a time before the primordial. Once cracked, the high heaven and nine worlds appeared.

Four words among them combined into a blinding radiance.

“Splendor.” Li Qiye opened his eyes wide.

The light turned everything into stone without exception. The whole ocean of tribulations became petrified.

“Run!” Spectators fled in horror. Alas, they couldn’t outrun the light despite the distance and their great speed.

“Zzz...” They turned into statues in the blink of an eye.

All of Dusk Realm was next to its inhabitants’ dismay. The next target was Heavenfall Path.

Its endless void became petrified instantly. Ruin and its tribulations were next and finally, Heavenrealm.

“A calamity is coming!” The major worlds fell into chaos.

As the light known as Splendor illuminated Heavenrealm, Heaven Essence Platform unleashed another ultimate attack.

“Clank!” Everyone saw the slash clearly.

“The enforcer’s slash!” A primordial immortal in Heavenrealm shouted.

“Again?!” Other immortals couldn’t believe it.

No one expected Heavenly Whale to unleash a slash similar to the enforcer's against Li Qiye. This was beyond the means of apex power.

Of course, this was due to the platform absorbing the tribulations and the creation curse, granting it enough power to duplicate the slash.

Previously, the slash was stopped by the involvement of the celestial immortals, including Octopus and Hidden Immortal. The price was nearly their whole force.

Today, who could stop it and save Heavenrealm from being cut into two halves or something worse?

“You are not the enforcer, this slash has no power.” Li Qiye pushed out his palm to stop it.

However, the petrification still surrounded him. He raised one finger and everything came to a halt.

Li Qiye faced the light illuminating him, preventing it from inching forward. As he stood there, he also tried to look at the source of the light.

“Boom!” A shadowy figure appeared in his mind.

This figure was the high heaven sitting in a meditative pose, capable of crushing Li Qiye.

“This is the forbidden realm of the high heaven, no living being shall trespass.” The figure spoke, capable of freezing celestial immortals with words alone.

However, Li Qiye brushed the air and said: “Acting against the wrong person.”

“Pop!” The shadow collapsed, revealing an old man with a faint radiance. The light behind him was much more impressive - the source of the petrification.
